entries.description:
Brightness: the platform's minimal template model. Generates animated
gradient video frames plus a swept audio tone, with a client-controllable
brightness multiplier, pause state, and configurable resolution
(480p-1440p). CPU-only; no weights.
entries.name: reactor/brightness

entries.description:
Echo passes the client's webcam and microphone straight back over WebRTC,
optionally applying a real-time video effect (grayscale, sepia, edges,
invert, blur, pixelate) and an uploaded overlay image. CPU-only; the
platform's always-on smoke-test model.
entries.name: reactor/echo

entries.description:
Interactive, single-GPU autoregressive text-to-video world model. Streams
generated video chunk by chunk over WebRTC from a text prompt (optionally
seeded by an uploaded image), steerable mid-stream, with a real-time ESRGAN
super-resolution pass on the displayed frames.
entries.name: reactor/helios

entries.description:
LingBot-World: interactive, multi-GPU image-to-video world model on the
WAN i2v-A14B fast path. Seeds from an uploaded image and autoregressively
streams camera-controllable video over WebRTC, steerable mid-stream, with
an optional ESRGAN/SPAN super-resolution pass. Runs DeepSpeed-Ulysses
sequence parallelism across the pod's GPUs.
entries.name: reactor/lingbot

entries.description:
LingBot-World V2: interactive, multi-GPU image-to-video world model on the
WAN i2v-A14B fast path. Seeds from an uploaded image and autoregressively
streams camera-controllable video over WebRTC, steerable mid-stream, with
an optional ESRGAN/SPAN super-resolution pass. V2 adds native 4x4
camera-pose layer control and DiT kernel optimisations over v1. Runs
DeepSpeed-Ulysses sequence parallelism across the pod's GPUs.
entries.name: reactor/lingbot-world-2

entries.description:
LongLive 2.0: interactive, single-GPU image-to-video world model on the
Wan2.2-TI2V-5B path. Seeds from an uploaded image and autoregressively
streams 1280x704 video over WebRTC with multi-shot scene cuts and
mid-stream prompt steering, with optional VFI and super-resolution passes.
entries.name: reactor/longlive-v2

entries.description:
Morpheus V4: real-time autoregressive text-to-video model. Streams
generated 1280x720 video chunk by chunk over WebRTC from a text prompt,
steerable mid-stream. Runs multi-GPU (causal + bidirectional fast-forward
generators on a Wan VAE / UMT5 / CLIP stack).
entries.name: reactor/morpheus-v4

entries.description:
Interactive, single-GPU streaming video editor. Transforms the client's
live camera stream chunk by chunk from a text prompt, steerable mid-stream,
on the self-forcing fixed-RoPE SANA V2V path.
entries.name: reactor/sana-streaming

entries.description:
X2: streaming video-to-video editing. The client streams a source video
and the model re-renders it live, guided by a text prompt (character
swap / insertion), an optional reference image of the character or
object to put into the scene, and an optional drag pointer that steers
the motion of the edited subject. Causal block-streaming Wan2.2-based
DiT: 4 frames per block, KV/VAE caches carried across blocks.
entries.name: xmax/x2
